statement: Moore Threads held gross margin at 56.95% with gross profit of 989 million yuan (about $146.8 million), up 103.78% year-on-year, and narrowed net loss by 95.73% to -11.56 million yuan.
why: An alternative GPU supplier approaching breakeven at healthy margin can sustain and scale production rather than depending on subsidy, making it a durable second source.

impact.mechanism: Sustainable margins and shrinking losses let a non-incumbent accelerator vendor fund capacity, adding alternative supply while eroding incumbent share in China.

evidence.excerpt: Total gross profit of 989 million yuan (approximately $146.8 million), up 103.78% year-on-year, with overall gross margin holding at a healthy 56.95%.
Net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company was -11.56 million yuan (approximately $1.7 million), a dramatic 95.73% narrowing of losses

confidence.basis: Secondary financial-news summary of reported results; single publisher.
